m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Grr. The Armory is restricted to Enforcers only. You know the rules. I suggest you leave before we arrest you on curfew violation.
Very well. Then we will just look the other way this time. In fact, we'll just go the other way.
It's about time! I've been waiting over an hour. That stroganoff better not be cold!
Wait a minute. You don't look like the serving girl. What are you doing in here?
Umph! I guess I will go out for stroganoff today.
<ITALICS> You stamp Bearyshnakov's papers with the Marshal's Seal, authorizing him to leave the city. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS> Now you need only to deliver the papers to the Captain of The Hummingbird down at the Harbor. </ITALICS>
Want a fresh start? Come to the New World! Gold and cookies for everyone! Book passage on The Hummingbird today!
Ah, the papers for the dancer. Very well, and he paid in advance, so tell him his space is secure and we leave in the morning.
You secured my place on the Hummingbird? I cannot wait. This New World sounds almost too good to be true!
The way the Empress has treated me is one thing, but now her guards have thrown my friend into the Basstille. Ivan the Great himself.
You know of Ivan? Ah. He was one of the greatest performers of all time. Together, we packed circus tents from here to Tundaria.
For Ivan's sake, I will help you steal the key to the Basstille. First though, we must ensure I can defect from this dreadful place.
To leave the city, I need you to go to the Armory and stamp my papers with the Marshal's Seal. You may have to fight.
Once the papers are stamped, take them to the captain of a ship called The Hummingbird in the harbor. Do this, and we have a deal.
Get my papers stamped with the Marshal's Seal and give them to the ship's captain. Then I will help get the key to the Basstille.
